initiative.title: Hecate's Cemetery: the first Planetary Villa expansion
initiative.body: Planetary Villa is a world on the Verse with game expansions. Hecate's Cemetery is the first: a moonlit, low-poly memorial garden seen from a Breath of the Wild camera, where you bring your pet back as a glowing companion, give it a tombstone and a memorial page, play fetch, pick glowing flowers and meet other visitors. Owner: Kiki.

milestones.title: Planetary Villa on the galaxy map, and the flight to Hecate's Cemetery
milestones.body: Pick Planetary Villa on the galaxy map and a short cinematic carries you to this session's expansion.

milestones.title: The moonlit cemetery and its field
milestones.body: The cemetery garden, its paths and tombstones, and the open field beside it, lit only by the moon.

milestones.title: You, the visitor from another realm
milestones.body: Your character: a shadow with soft edges and a trail of particles.

milestones.title: Bring your pet: make and customize its avatar
milestones.body: Upload text, images or video about your pet, late or new; an agent builds a glowing avatar you customize, with emotes and skills.

milestones.title: Tombstones and memorial pages
milestones.body: Each pet gets a tombstone in the garden and a memorial page with its stories and achievements, shareable by link.

milestones.title: Play with your pet
milestones.body: Fetch and the pet's skills in the field, emotes, and visiting other tombstones.

milestones.title: Others in the garden, and the chat
milestones.body: A multiplayer world with a chat box like Horse Isle.

milestones.title: The glowing flowers mini game
milestones.body: Collect three kinds of glowing flowers, arrange them in a vase, and place it, by the tombstone first.

milestones.title: Tutorial, analytics and launch
milestones.body: The first-visit tutorial, analytics on every step, safety, and the public launch.

tasks.title: Write down Planetary Villa and Hecate's Cemetery as Kiki described them
tasks.body: Turn Kiki's description into the design document `verse/planetary-villa/README.md`: the world, the expansion, the art direction, every mechanic and the flower mini game, with open questions for Kiki. Kiki owns the design; the document is hers to correct.
acceptance: verse/planetary-villa/README.md covers every mechanic in the project's tasks
Kiki has read it and her corrections are in

tasks.title: Planetary Villa appears on the galaxy map and opens
tasks.body:
Planetary Villa is a planet you can choose on the galaxy map; choosing it starts the flight to the current expansion.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): pt-galaxy, pt-planets. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Choosing Planetary Villa on the galaxy map at openagents.com opens the flight
Analytics records the choice

tasks.title: The flight to Hecate's Cemetery: a short cinematic
tasks.body:
A skippable cinematic of traveling through space to the expansion this session focuses on (Hecate's Cemetery), ending where you land in the garden.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-cinematics. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: The cinematic plays on desktop and phone and can be skipped
It ends at the garden's entrance with control handed to you

tasks.title: The art kit: simple stylized low-poly garden, tombstones, paths and field
tasks.body: A small set of low-poly models in one stylized look: tombstones (several shapes with room for a name and epitaph), garden beds, hedges, trees, gates, benches, a fountain, path pieces, the open field's edge. Sources must be licensed for our use; list each source.
acceptance: Every model loads in the Verse and fits one style
Licences recorded next to the assets

tasks.title: Everything lit by moonlight: dim, blue, with outlines
tasks.body:
The garden at night: moonlight as the only key light, not very bright, soft shadows, a light outline on shapes and paths so they read in the dark.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-moonlight, verse-outlines. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Side-by-side screenshots at desktop and phone show the moonlit look Kiki approves
Frame time stays inside the realm's budget on a phone

tasks.title: The cemetery garden and the field beside it
tasks.body:
Lay out the garden: paths between tombstone plots with room to grow, a gate into the open field, and spots for the vase and the fountain. Paths are walkable and readable from the third-person view.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-terrain-paths. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: You can walk every path and into the field
Plots for at least 64 tombstones, added as pets arrive

tasks.title: A third-person camera like Breath of the Wild
tasks.body:
The Breath of the Wild perspective: an over-the-shoulder third-person camera that orbits freely, with the walking controller the Haunted House uses, on keyboard, mouse and touch.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-orbit-camera. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Orbit, zoom and follow feel right on desktop and phone
No clipping through tombstones or hedges

tasks.title: Your character: an all-black humanoid with fuzzy edges
tasks.body:
The visitor is mostly a shadow: an all-black humanoid with soft, fuzzy edges, not detailed.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-soft-silhouette. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: The shadow reads clearly against the moonlit garden
Its edges look soft at desktop and phone sizes

tasks.title: Particles that show you're visiting from another realm
tasks.body:
A light trail of particles around the visitor while it moves, so it reads as a guest from another realm.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-particles. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: The particles follow you and stay within the frame budget on a phone

tasks.title: Tell us about your pet: text, images or video
tasks.body:
A create-your-pet flow drawn in Coax: write about your pet, and drop in photos or a short video, for a late pet or a new one. Uploads are stored privately with size and type limits, and only used to build the avatar.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): pt-player-endpoints. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Text, image and video uploads work on desktop and phone
Uploads are private, limited in size and type, and deletable by their owner

tasks.title: An agent turns what you shared into your pet's avatar
tasks.body: An agent reads the text, images and video and sets the avatar's parameters: species and breed shape, size, proportions, coat colours and pattern, ears, tail, and the details that made the pet theirs. Model calls go through our Google-first provider routing.
acceptance: From a photo and a sentence, the avatar is recognisably that pet to its owner in a playtest
Each choice the agent made is shown and can be changed

tasks.title: Customize your pet's avatar, like in the Sims
tasks.body:
An editor drawn in Coax: change shape, proportions, colours, pattern and accessories with sliders and swatches, seeing the pet turn and move as you change it. The pet glows white in the world.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-quadruped, verse-glow. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Every parameter the agent sets can be changed by hand
The glowing white look matches Kiki's art direction

tasks.title: Emotes to choose from, and new ones the agent makes
tasks.body:
A set of emotes (sit, play bow, roll over, howl, wag, sleep) to choose from, and new ones an agent makes from what you say about the pet ("she always spun twice before lying down").

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-authored-motions. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: At least six stock emotes play on the pet
An agent-made emote from a sentence plays in the world

tasks.title: Skills: fetch, obedience, digging holes
tasks.body: The pet's skills, chosen when you make it: fetch, obedience (sit, stay, come), digging holes, and room for more. Skills decide what the pet can do in the field.
acceptance: Each skill has a visible action in the field
Skills are saved with the pet

tasks.title: A tombstone for each pet in the garden
tasks.body:
When you press play, your pet's tombstone takes a plot in the garden: its name, dates and a line, with its achievements if it was competitive and its most beloved traits and stories.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): pt-saves. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: A new pet's tombstone appears in the garden for every visitor
Walking up to a tombstone shows its name, line and a link to the memorial

tasks.title: The memorial page: stories, achievements and testimonials
tasks.body: A memorial page for each pet, drawn in Coax: its avatar, stories, achievements and beloved traits, and testimonials from people who knew it. Linked from the tombstone.
acceptance: Every pet has a memorial page linked from its tombstone
The owner can edit it and remove testimonials

tasks.title: A shareable link for each memorial
tasks.body: Each memorial page has a short shareable link with a share card (the pet's avatar in moonlight), so it can be sent to family and friends.
acceptance: The link opens the memorial for someone signed out
The share card shows in messages and social posts

tasks.title: Play fetch in the field
tasks.body:
Throw a ball in the open field; a pet with the fetch skill runs, picks it up and brings it back.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-throw-physics, verse-quadruped. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Fetch works with mouse, keys and touch
The pet's run and pickup look natural

tasks.title: Walk the garden with your pet and visit other tombstones
tasks.body: Your pet follows you through the garden; other pets' tombstones can be visited and their memorials opened.
acceptance: The pet follows without getting stuck on paths and hedges
Any tombstone's memorial opens from the world

tasks.title: Other visitors and their pets in the garden
tasks.body:
A multiplayer garden: see other visitors' shadows and their glowing pets moving in real time.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): pt-presence-chat. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Two visitors see each other and each other's pets within two seconds
Room size is bounded

tasks.title: A chat box like Horse Isle
tasks.body:
A chat box in the corner for everyone in the garden, in the style of Horse Isle, drawn in Coax, with names and the pet each visitor brought.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): pt-presence-chat. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Chat works between two visitors on desktop and phone
Messages are bounded and moderated

tasks.title: Three kinds of glowing flowers to collect in the field
tasks.body:
Glowing flowers of three kinds grow in the field; walk up and pick them, and they go in your basket.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-glow, verse-particles. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: All three kinds grow, glow and can be picked
Picked flowers regrow after a while

tasks.title: Arrange flowers in a vase, point and click
tasks.body:
A close-up arranging view: point and click to put each flower in the vase where you want it.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): verse-closeup-arrange. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: Arranging works with a mouse and with touch
The arrangement is saved with the vase

tasks.title: Place the vase anywhere; the tutorial leads you to the tombstone
tasks.body:
Carry the vase and set it down anywhere in the world. The tutorial directs you to place it by your pet's tombstone. Placed vases stay for everyone.

Blocked by Verse engine work, tracked in the Verse project (https://openagents.com/projects/verse): pt-saves. This task can't land until those are done.
acceptance: A vase can be placed anywhere walkable
The tutorial step points to the tombstone
Placed vases persist and other visitors see them

tasks.title: The first visit: a gentle tutorial
tasks.body: From landing to making your pet, playing fetch, picking flowers and placing the vase by the tombstone: one tip at a time, in the realm's plate style.
acceptance: A first-time visitor finishes the loop without help in a playtest

tasks.title: Analytics on every step
tasks.body: Record each step (galaxy choice, flight, pet made, emotes, fetch, flowers, vase, memorial shares) through the openagents.com analytics.
acceptance: Each step appears on the analytics dashboard

tasks.title: Safety for uploads, memorials and chat
tasks.body: Uploads, memorial text, testimonials and chat are moderated: limits, reporting, the owner's removal, and a review queue. Grief is personal; nothing a visitor shares is used for anything but their pet.
acceptance: Reporting and removal work for each kind of content
Upload use is limited to the pet's avatar, and said so on the upload screen

tasks.title: The review queue as a page: open reports with hide, keep and restore
tasks.body: Reports only reach an admin through GET /api/villa/reports today. Draw the queue in Coax at /admin/reports, beside /admin/analytics and behind the same admin login: every open report (what it is, how many reported it, what it said, why), with HIDE and KEEP on each, and the recent decisions with RESTORE on what was hidden. Hiding is reversible: a hidden memorial, note, photo or chat line is held, not deleted, until an admin restores it or its owner deletes it.
acceptance: An admin logged in at /admin/analytics opens /admin/reports and sees each open report once
HIDE, KEEP and RESTORE work from the page and the queue updates
Anyone else sees ADMINS ONLY and nothing more
test_villa.py and admin.coax's checks pass

tasks.title: The photos and videos you shared, on the memorial
tasks.body: Uploads are kept but never shown, while the upload screen says they're for the avatar and the memorial. The owner chooses which photos and videos the memorial shows (none until they do, since the screen promised only they see them); the memorial draws them in Coax, a video muted and looping, served from the private bucket only while the memorial is placed and the file is shown. A shown photo or video can be reported like the rest of the memorial.
acceptance: A photo and a video the owner shows appear on the memorial for someone logged out, on desktop and phone
A file the owner hasn't shown, or has deleted, can't be fetched by anyone else
The upload screen says what the memorial shows
A shown file can be reported and hidden by an admin

tasks.title: Agent-made emotes, checked once against the real model
tasks.body: The emote agent (0032_villa_emotes.sql) was built against a fake model. Ask Gemini on Vertex AI (Google first) for emotes from a few real sentences, run each answer through the engine's motion check the way the page does, and fix whatever a real answer breaks: the prompt, the parsing or the retry.
acceptance: Several sentences give motions the engine accepts and plays, from the real model
Whatever a real answer broke is fixed and has a check

tasks.title: Kiki's review and the public launch
tasks.body: Kiki plays the whole expansion and signs off; then it goes public.
acceptance: Kiki has signed off
The expansion is reachable from the galaxy map for everyone
